meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: Claude 会把一份 DAG 定义存成 JSON 文件放进库目录,之后按名字加载并启动运行,不必每次把定义重新粘贴一遍。加载时它会旋转 key 并填充 {{key}}、{{date}} 等占位符。
howto.when: 当你想保存一个 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或重复调度同一个多智能体图时触发。全新图请先读 mass-ulw。

say.text: 把当前这个 DAG 保存为 nightly-audit

say.note: 默认旋转 key,每次都是新运行
同后缀复用同一逻辑运行

howto.what_en: Claude stores a DAG definition as a JSON file in the library dirs, then loads and starts it by name instead of re-pasting the definition each run. On load it rotates the key and fills {{key}}, {{date}} and similar placeholders.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly. For authoring a new graph, read mass-ulw first.

say_en.text: Save the current DAG as nightly-audit
say_en.note: Writes to ~/.omo/dags and runs it once
Default rotation makes each call a fresh run
Same suffix reuses the same logical run
